attempted_claim: Let D_7 be the diagonal quartic surface x_0^4+4x_1^4+7x_2^4-7x_3^4=0 over Q, which satisfies D_7(Q) != empty and Br(D_7)=Br(Q). Is D_7(Q) dense in D_7(A_Q), i.e. does weak approximation hold for D_7?
decisive_failure: Weak approximation for the K3 surface D7 remains undecided: descent stalls after one divisibility step, searches are bounded (box B=300 and 624 reduced pairs), no fibration certificate exists, and trivial Brauer group removes all known obstructions.
